name: HPM5300EVK
description: HPMicro's evaluation board for the HPM5361 (480 MHz RISC-V): on-board FT2232 debugger, 2x20 IO expansion header, motor-control and sensor interfaces, ADC SMA input and CAN.
notes: No public price was found: HPMicro sells through distributors and Taobao; $35 is an estimate. The HPM5361 has no internal flash, so the board's external QSPI flash holds the code (8 MB is assumed).

The HPMicro page lists ADC SMA input, motor-control/sensor interface, 2x20 IO header, onboard debugger and JTAG; the CAN transceiver is inferred from the RT-Thread CAN support (and a search summary also mentioned LIN/RS-485/RS-422, not included). USB-C PWR_DEBUG port with FT2232 is from the RT-Thread README. Board size and GPIO count are estimates.
